# Container tool catalog

This page is the readable catalog surface. It replaces one-file-per-tool
summaries that repeated links and reported unknown smoke status without
helping a scientist choose or assess a tool.

Execution evidence and image integrity are independent from catalog metadata:
[real LUNARC runs](../../reports/run-evidence.md) and [immutable image inventory](../../reports/image-inventory.md).
